records.title: sans marque - fromage de chevre frais
records.hazard: escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; détruire le produit; echange; les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.title: scic des abattoirs du comminges - steak haché
records.hazard: escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; rapporter le produit au point de vente; autre (voir informations complémentaires); les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; rapporter le produit au point de vente; autre (voir informations complémentaires); les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.title: sans marque - fromage de chevre frais
records.hazard: escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; détruire le produit; echange; les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.hazard: escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; détruire le produit; echange; les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.title: chevenet - fromage de chevre frais
records.hazard: escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; ne plus utiliser le produit; détruire le produit; echange; les escherichia coli shiga toxinogène (stec) peuvent entraîner dans la semaine qui suit la consommation de produits contaminés, des diarrhées parfois sanglantes, des douleurs abdominales et des vomissements, accompagnés ou non de fièvre. ces symptômes peuvent être suivis (5 à 8% des cas) de complications rénales sévères, principalement chez les enfants. les personnes qui auraient consommé les produits mentionnés ci-dessus et qui présenteraient ce type de symptômes sont invitées à consulter sans délai leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation ainsi que le lieu et la date d'achat. en l'absence de symptôme dans les 15 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. d'une façon générale, les autorités sanitaires rappellent que par précaution pour les populations plus sensibles comme les enfants, les personnes âgées ou immunodéprimées, les femmes enceintes, il est recommandé de cuire à cœur (70°c) les viandes hachées et les produits à base de viande hachée. il faut également éviter la consommation de lait cru et de produits au lait cru. il faut préférer les fromages à pâte pressée cuite (type emmental, comté, etc.), les fromages fondus à tartiner et les fromages au lait pasteurisé. il faut éviter également la consommation de produits crus ou insuffisamment cuits à base de farine (pâtes à cookies, pâtes à pizza …). les végétaux devraient être lavés soigneusement ou épluchés ou cuits avant d'être consommés.

records.hazard: salmonella spp (agent responsable de la salmonellose)
records.remedy: contacter le point de vente; détruire le produit; remboursement; les toxi-infections alimentaires causées par les salmonelles se traduisent par des troubles gastro-intestinaux (diarrhée, vomissements) d'apparition brutale souvent accompagnés de fièvre et de maux de tête qui surviennent généralement 6h à 72h après la consommation des produits contaminés. ces symptômes peuvent être plus prononcés chez les jeunes enfants, les femmes enceintes, les sujets immunodéprimés et les personnes âgées. les personnes qui auraient consommé ces produits et qui présenteraient ces symptômes sont invitées à consulter leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation. en l'absence de symptômes dans les 7 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. si le produit doit subir une cuisson avant consommation : la cuisson à cœur des produits (œufs durs, pâtisseries, viandes de volailles…) à +65°c permet de détruire ces bactéries et de prévenir les conséquences d'une telle contamination.

records.remedy: ne plus consommer; rapporter le produit au point de vente; contacter le service consommateur; détruire le produit; remboursement; les toxi-infections alimentaires à histamine apparaissent en ½ heure à quelques heures après la consommation du plat responsable et consistent en une allergie aiguë. les symptômes observés sont classiquement des rougeurs et un « gonflement » du visage, des maux de tête, une sensation de chaleur et de malaise, associés à des signes digestifs (nausées, vomissements, diarrhée). les personnes à terrain allergique sont particulièrement concernées car elles peuvent en outre présenter des troubles respiratoires aigus : elles doivent absolument s'abstenir de consommer les denrées mentionnées et, en cas d'apparition de tels symptômes, consulter sans délai le service des urgences. la rémission est habituellement spontanée et accélérée grâce à l'administration d'un anti-histaminique.

records.hazard: salmonella spp (agent responsable de la salmonellose)
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; rapporter le produit au point de vente; remboursement; les toxi-infections alimentaires causées par les salmonelles se traduisent par des troubles gastro-intestinaux (diarrhée, vomissements) d'apparition brutale souvent accompagnés de fièvre et de maux de tête qui surviennent généralement 6h à 72h après la consommation des produits contaminés. ces symptômes peuvent être plus prononcés chez les jeunes enfants, les femmes enceintes, les sujets immunodéprimés et les personnes âgées. les personnes qui auraient consommé ces produits et qui présenteraient ces symptômes sont invitées à consulter leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation. en l'absence de symptômes dans les 7 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. si le produit doit subir une cuisson avant consommation : la cuisson à cœur des produits (œufs durs, pâtisseries, viandes de volailles…) à +65°c permet de détruire ces bactéries et de prévenir les conséquences d'une telle contamination.

records.remedy: ne plus consommer; rapporter le produit au point de vente; contacter le service consommateur; détruire le produit; remboursement; les toxi-infections alimentaires causées par les salmonelles se traduisent par des troubles gastro-intestinaux (diarrhée, vomissements) d'apparition brutale souvent accompagnés de fièvre et de maux de tête qui surviennent généralement 6h à 72h après la consommation des produits contaminés. ces symptômes peuvent être plus prononcés chez les jeunes enfants, les femmes enceintes, les sujets immunodéprimés et les personnes âgées. les personnes qui auraient consommé ces produits et qui présenteraient ces symptômes sont invitées à consulter leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation. en l'absence de symptômes dans les 7 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. si le produit doit subir une cuisson avant consommation : la cuisson à cœur des produits (œufs durs, pâtisseries, viandes de volailles…) à +65°c permet de détruire ces bactéries et de prévenir les conséquences d'une telle contamination.

records.hazard: toxines endogènes : histamine
records.remedy: ne plus consommer; rapporter le produit au point de vente; contacter le point de vente; remboursement; les toxi-infections alimentaires à histamine apparaissent en ½ heure à quelques heures après la consommation du plat responsable et consistent en une allergie aiguë. les symptômes observés sont classiquement des rougeurs et un « gonflement » du visage, des maux de tête, une sensation de chaleur et de malaise, associés à des signes digestifs (nausées, vomissements, diarrhée). les personnes à terrain allergique sont particulièrement concernées car elles peuvent en outre présenter des troubles respiratoires aigus : elles doivent absolument s'abstenir de consommer les denrées mentionnées et, en cas d'apparition de tels symptômes, consulter sans délai le service des urgences. la rémission est habituellement spontanée et accélérée grâce à l'administration d'un anti-histaminique.

records.remedy: ne plus consommer; rapporter le produit au point de vente; contacter le point de vente; détruire le produit; echange; les toxi-infections alimentaires causées par les salmonelles se traduisent par des troubles gastro-intestinaux (diarrhée, vomissements) d'apparition brutale souvent accompagnés de fièvre et de maux de tête qui surviennent généralement 6h à 72h après la consommation des produits contaminés. ces symptômes peuvent être plus prononcés chez les jeunes enfants, les femmes enceintes, les sujets immunodéprimés et les personnes âgées. les personnes qui auraient consommé ces produits et qui présenteraient ces symptômes sont invitées à consulter leur médecin traitant en lui signalant cette consommation. en l'absence de symptômes dans les 7 jours après la consommation des produits concernés, il est inutile de s'inquiéter et de consulter un médecin. si le produit doit subir une cuisson avant consommation : la cuisson à cœur des produits (œufs durs, pâtisseries, viandes de volailles…) à +65°c permet de détruire ces bactéries et de prévenir les conséquences d'une telle contamination.

records.title: C. A. M. P. Mountain Ice Axes recalled due to fall hazard
productNames: C. A. M. P. X-Dream, X-Dream Total Dry, X-All Mountain Hammer and X-All Mountain Adze
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fall hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact C. A. M. P. USA Inc. to obtain a free repair kit.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Sports and fitness Product: C. A. M. P. X-Dream, X-Dream Total Dry, X-All Mountain Hammer and X-All Mountain Adze Summary product: C. A. M. P. X-Dream, X-Dream Total Dry, X-All Mountain Hammer and X-All Mountain Adze Issue: Fall hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 5 This recall involves X-Dream, X-Dream Total Dry, X-All Mountain Hammer and X-All Mountain Adze technical ice axes. These products are designed for vertical ice climbing. The batch number is located on the side of the shaft. “C. A. M. P.” is written in white lettering on the ice axes shafts. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact C. A. M. P. USA Inc. for either a free repair kit with instructions to repair the axes themselves or to have the firm repair the ice axes using a prepaid shipping label and packaging to return the recalled axes to C. A. M. P. USA Inc. For more information, consumers can contact C. A. M. P. USA Inc. by telephone at 1-877-421-2267, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Mountain Time (US), Monday to Friday, by email at warranties@camp-usa.com or visit https://www.camp-usa.com/x-bolt-recall-102026 or go to www.camp-usa.com and click on “Safety Recalls” at the bottom of the page for more information. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using and charging the recalled product and dispose of it by contacting your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries. Contact the company for a refund.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: Ororo PD10K-Pro Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Summary product: Ororo PD10K-Pro Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Consumers should immediately stop using or charging the recalled product, and safely dispose of the items in such a way that they cannot be used again. Contact the company for a refund. Contact your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries. Batteries are considered hazardous waste. Do not place them in household garbage. For more information, consumers can contact Langis LLC by telephone at 1-702-751-7639, from 9 am to 6 pm Eastern Time, Monday to Friday, or visit the company website. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Langis LLC. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Specialized products Product: Scotch™ Thermal Laminators TL1302Z Summary product: Scotch™ Thermal Laminators TL1302Z Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled laminator, unplug the device, and register online for a product reimbursement in the form of a voucher. Consumers can then safely dispose of the recalled product in accordance with municipal electronic waste requirements. For more information, consumers can contact 3M Company by telephone at 1-800-364-3577 between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm EST Monday through Friday or visit the company website. records.description: Published by: Controlled substances and cannabis Category: Consumer products Product: Radon testing devices, including electronic radon monitors and detector kits used to measure radon levels in homes. Summary product: Radon testing devices, including electronic radon monitors and detector kits used to measure radon levels in homes. Issue: Impact hazard - Injury hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Impact hazard Test your home for radon. The best time to test is during winter, when homes are more tightly sealed and radon levels are often higher. Use an approved long-term radon test lasting at least three months. This will provide the most accurate assessment of your home's average radon level. Only purchase electronic radon monitors that have passed performance testing by the Canadian National Radon Proficiency Program (C-NRPP), the Canadian radon certification program recognized by Health Canada. If you have purchased a recalled electronic radon detector, stop using it and dispose of it according to municipal electronic waste requirements. Report any incidents involving a consumer product to Health Canada: Consumer Product Incident Report Form. Related links:Radon - Canada.ca Take Action on radon Guide for radon measurements in homes - Canada.ca

records.title: Disposable vaping device GTMBAR 45K recalled due to lack of child-resistant packaging
records.hazard: Consumer products - Labelling and packaging
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product, keep it out of the reach of children, and dispose of it in accordance with municipal hazardous waste disposal guidelines.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Chemicals Product: Disposable vaping device GTMBAR 45K Summary product: Disposable vaping device GTMBAR 45K Issue: Labelling and packaging Summary issue: Consumer products - Labelling and packaging Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves the disposable vaping device GTMBAR 45K. The GTM BAR 45K, branded GTMBAR, is a disposable vaping device equipped with a rechargeable USB-C battery. It consists of a device containing 1.75 m L of e-liquid and a separate 18.25 m L prefilled container that is inserted during initial setup, for a total capacity of 20 m L. The nicotine concentration is 20 mg/m L. Identifiers: 6942111921444, 6942111921437 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product, keep it out of the reach of children, and dispose of it in accordance with municipal hazardous waste disposal guidelines. For more information, consumers may contact Cigarettes Électroniques LK Vape Inc. by telephone at (450) 434-8813 ext. 101, Monday to Friday, from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, or by email at info@lkvape.ca. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Health Canada warns about unauthorized peptides, including contaminated injectable peptides sold by Sage & Summit Wellness Co. in Ottawa, ON
records.hazard: Health products - Unauthorized product
records.remedy: Do not buy or use these products. If you have used an unauthorized peptide product and feel unwell, seek medical attention. If you injected it and you develop a fever or pain and swelling at the injection site or you feel unwell, seek immediate medical attention. Only buy prescription drugs from licensed pharmacies . Check labels: authorized health products have an eight-digit Drug Identification Number (DIN) or Natural Product Number (NPN) printed on the label.
records.description: Published by: Controlled substances and cannabis Category: Drugs Product: Unauthorized peptides (injectable and capsule format) Summary product: Unauthorized peptides (injectable and capsule format) Issue: Unauthorized product - Contamination Summary issue: Health products - Unauthorized product Affected products table entries: 2 If you have used an unauthorized peptide product and experience adverse effects or feel unwell, seek medical attention. If you have injected it and you develop redness, swelling, pain at the injection site, fever, or chills, seek immediate medical attention, as these may be signs of a serious infection. Do not buy or use unauthorized health products. Authorized health products have an eight-digit Drug Identification Number (DIN) or Natural Product Number (NPN) on the label. You can also check whether a drug has been authorized for sale by searching Health Canada's Drug Product Database or Licensed Natural Health Products Database. Do not use drugs that are labelled with any variation of “For Research Use Only”. These are intended for lab use, not human consumption, and can be dangerous to your health. Use prescription drugs under the care of a healthcare professional and only buy prescription drugs from licensed pharmacies. Be aware of the risks of buying health products online. Dispose of unauthorized peptide products by following municipal or regional guidance for chemicals and other hazardous waste or take the product to your local pharmacy for proper disposal. Report any health product-related side effects or complaints to Health Canada. Your reports help identify potentially dangerous products and protect others from harm. Visit Health Canada’s webpage on Peptides to learn more about peptides, their health risks, and steps you can take to protect yourself. Related links:Health Canada peptide safety advisories Health Canada information on peptides

records.title: Health Canada warns about contaminated unauthorized injectable peptides and non-peptide drugs
productNames: Unauthorized injectable peptide and non-peptide drugs
records.hazard: Health products - Unauthorized product
records.remedy: Do not buy or use these products. If you have used them and develop a fever or pain and swelling at the injection site or you feel unwell, seek immediate medical attention. Only buy prescription drugs from licensed pharmacies . Check labels: authorized drugs for sale in Canada have an 8-digit Drug Identification Number (DIN) printed on the label.
records.description: Published by: Controlled substances and cannabis Category: Drugs Product: Unauthorized injectable peptide and non-peptide drugs Summary product: Unauthorized injectable peptide and non-peptide drugs Issue: Unauthorized product - Contamination Summary issue: Health products - Unauthorized product If you have used an unauthorized injectable peptide drug and develop symptoms such as redness, swelling, pain at the injection site, fever, chills or you feel unwell, seek medical attention immediately, as these may be signs of a serious infection. Do not buy or use unauthorized drugs. Authorized prescription drugs in Canada have an eight-digit Drug Identification Number (DIN) on the label. You can also check whether a drug has been authorized for sale by searching Health Canada's Drug Product Database. Do not use drugs that are labelled "For Research Use Only – Not for Human Consumption". These are intended for lab use, not human consumption and can be dangerous to your health. Only use prescription drugs prescribed to you under the care of a licensed healthcare professional, and only buy prescription drugs from licensed pharmacies. Be aware of the risks of buying health products online. Dispose of unauthorized peptide drugs by following municipal or regional guidance for chemicals and other hazardous waste or take the product to your local pharmacy for proper disposal. Report any health product-related side effects or complaints to Health Canada. Your reports help identify potentially dangerous products and protect others from harm. Visit Health Canada's Webpage on Peptides to learn more about peptides, their health risks, and steps you can take to protect yourself. Related links Health Canada peptide safety advisories Health Canada information on peptides

records.title: ​​Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swings​ recalled due to fall hazard
productNames: Blue Compression Sensory Swing with Swivel
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fall hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Harkla to obtain a repair kit.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swings Summary product: Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swings Issue: Fall hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Harkla Children’s Compression Sensory Swings that have a blue fabric seat and come with a four-hole ceiling hook mounting plate for suspension, with a drop length of 18 to 24 inches. The SKUs that are included in the recall are in the table below. The SKU number is printed on the side of the product packaging. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Harkla to obtain a repair kit. The repair kit consists of a replacement ceiling hook mounting plate, a safety strap and updated swing installation instructions. Consumers will be asked to go to https://harkla.co/pages/ceiling-hook-recall-2026 to register. Consumers should then dispose of the hooks according to municipal waste guidelines. For more information, consumers can contact Harkla by telephone at 844-442-7552 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, by email at recall@harkla.co or visit the company website at https://harkla.co/pages/ceiling-hook-recall-2026 or https://harkla.co and click “Recall” at the top of the page. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Harkla. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.hazard: Consumer products - Impact hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Ariston Canada Inc., to obtain a free upgrade kit and assistance in arranging to have a certified technician install the upgrade kit to your boiler.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Residential Gas Boilers Summary product: Residential Gas Boilers Issue: Impact hazard - Poisoning hazard - Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Impact hazard Affected products table entries: 10 This recall involves NTI brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN and TFTN model series, and HTP brand residential gas boilers in the EFTU model series. The serial number can be found on the rating plate, located on the side panel of the boiler cabinet. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled boilers and contact Ariston Canada Inc. to obtain an upgrade kit and assistance in arranging to have a technician install the upgrade kit on your boiler, free of charge. Consumers who must continue using the boiler while awaiting repair should have working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in their homes. For more information, consumers can contact Ariston Canada Inc. by telephone at 1-800-688-2575, Monday through Friday, from 7:00 am to 8:00 pm ET, by email at VCexchanger@ariston.com or online at https://ntiboilers.com/safety-recalls or www.ntiboilers.com and click on “RECALLS” at the top of the page or https://htproducts.com/safety-notice.html or www.htproducts.com and click on “URGENT RECALL” at the top of the page. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Ariston Canada. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.hazard: Consumer products - Choking hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and completely remove the textile label from the harness strap. Once the label has been removed, the child bicycle seat can continue to be used as intended.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Other Product: Hamax Buddy child seat Summary product: Hamax Buddy child seat Issue: Choking hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Choking hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Hamax Buddy child seat. This child bicycle seat is designed for bicycles that do not have a rear luggage rack, allowing installation on certain mountain and hybrid bicycles. Consumers must verify product compatibility with their bicycle's frame tube diameter prior to use. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and completely remove the textile label from the harness strap by cutting it off and pulling it out to eliminate the identified choking hazard. Once the label has been completely removed, the child bicycle seat can continue to be used as intended. For more information, consumers can contact Décathlon Canada Inc. by telephone at 1-844-533-3322, Monday to Friday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. or by email at onlineservice@decathlon.ca. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. productNames: Simmons Kozy and Nido Baby Nest/Lounger
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fall hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and safely dispose of it in such a way that it cannot be used again.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Simmons Kozy and Nido Baby Nest/Lounger Summary product: Simmons Kozy and Nido Baby Nest/Lounger Issue: Fall hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 6 This recall involves Simmons Kozy and Nido baby nests/loungers available in various colours and textures. The model number is located on the warning label on the product and the UPC came with product packaging. Identifiers: UPC 7 74021 59900 2, UPC 7 74021 59902 6, UPC 7 74021 59950 7, UPC 7 74021 59955 2, UPC 7 74021 59960 6, UPC 7 74021 59965 1 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and safely dispose of it in such a way that it cannot be used again. For more information, consumers can contact Jupiter Industries by telephone at 1-800-465-5795, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday, by email at customerservice@jupiterindustries.com or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

The Al Fakher Refill Pro Device Kit is a Crown Bar hookah-style, reusable, open-fill pod system designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) and direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and dispose of it. For more information, consumers can contact Genuine Vapes by telephone at 519-971-9398, from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. EST, by email at mike@genuinevapes.ca or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Sports and fitness Product: ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebar Summary product: ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebar Issue: Fall hazard - Injury hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 14 This recall involves certain Mondraker mountain bicycles equiped with ONOFF S9 Carbon MTB handlebars. The bicycle serial number is located on the underside of the bottom bracket area of the frame. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact an authorized Mondraker dealer to schedule a handlebar replacement. Consumers can verify whether their bicycle is affected through the serial number verification tool provided by Mondraker. For more information, consumers can contact Mondraker HQ by email at info@ogc.ca or visit the company website. records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Tylö Halmstad and Kiruna Hybrid Saunas Summary product: Tylö Halmstad and Kiruna Hybrid Saunas Issue: Fall hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 7 This recall involves bench seating in Sauna360’s Tylö branded Halmstad and Kiruna Hybrid sauna rooms. The serial number for each room can be found on both the packaging and the sauna rooms. The Halmstad 2, 3 and 4 sauna rooms have the serial number label located beneath the upper bench on the left side, directly above the electrical contactor box. The Kiruna Hybrid 2 and 3 rooms have the serial number label applied to the right wall, located beneath the right side of the upper bench. The model number is printed in the manual. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free repair by a professional installer to retrofit the benches with additional hardware and supports. For more information, consumers can contact Sauna360 by telephone at 1-866-936-5962, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday or by email at recall@sauna360.com. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit recalled due to fire hazard
productNames: S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Compo Closet USA Inc. to receive a free replacement. Dispose of it by contacting your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit Summary product: S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves the S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit. The product is a battery-powered waterless dry flush toilet with urine diversion and a heat-sealing mechanism, for campervans, caravans, motorhomes, boats and off-grid cabins. The identifying feature is the order/backer number rather than an individual unit serial number. Identifiers: UPC 5065015394525, UPC 5065015394518, 5065015394525, 5065015394518 Consumers should unplug the product's DC power plug if temperatures may drop below 3°C; stop using and unplug immediately if it may already have been charged below freezing. Contact Compo Closet USA Inc. to obtain a free replacement battery pack (available December 2026) or a free 12V bypass cable (already in transit to North America). Dispose of the removed battery at a local household hazardous-waste facility — not by post, household bin, or retail battery collection box. For more information, consumers can contact Compo Closet USA Inc. by email at s1-support@compocloset.com. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: Studio Six Headphone Amplifier Summary product: Studio Six Headphone Amplifier Issue: Electrical hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Electrical hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Studio Six Headphone Amplifiers. The amplifiers are black or silver. The amplifiers measure 36 cm (15.75 inches) high by 30 cm (12 inches) wide. The height for the lower level of the unit, top to bottom, is 10.8 cm (5.75 inches; the height from the top of the upper level to bottom of the unit is 48.9 cm (20.75 inches). At the front of the unit, there are four audio connectors for headphones. At the back, there are three sets (L and R) of RCA inputs. Also at the back is a connector for an auxiliary power device. Identifiers: UPC 729440682200, UPC 729440682194, 729440682200, 729440682194 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Audio Line Out to arrange a return and repair service. For more information, consumers can contact Audio Line Out by telephone at 971-279-4357, 10 am to 5 pm PST, Monday to Friday, by email at support@aloaudio.com or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. records.title: ​​Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys​ recalled due to choking hazard
productNames: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys (blue with dinosaurs)
records.hazard: Consumer products - Choking hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled products and contact Esjay to obtain a replacement page.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Toys and games Product: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys (blue with dinosaurs) Summary product: Esjay Toddler Busy Board Montessori Toys (blue with dinosaurs) Issue: Choking hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Choking hazard Consumers should immediately stop using the recall products and contact Esjay to obtain a replacement page. Consumers are to unzip the page with red small parts, write “RECALLED” on both sides of the page and throw it away. Send a photo of the disposed page to Esjay US at esjay-service@outlook.com to receive a replacement page. For more information, consumers can contact Esjay US at 1-888-206-9309 from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, by email at esjay-service@outlook.com, or online at www.esjay.store/recall or www.esjay.store and click “Recall” at the top of the page for more information. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Health Canada orders Junior Brands Corp. to recall Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller
productNames: Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller
records.hazard: Consumer products - Tip-over hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Junior Brand Corp for additional information on how to eliminate the hazards.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller Summary product: Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller Issue: Tip-over hazard - Entrapment hazard - Injury hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Tip-over hazard Affected products table entries: 5 This recall involves Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller sold in 5 colours: Night, Charcoal, Cappuccino, Cloud and Denim. Identifiers: UPC 9 315517 100480, UPC 9 315517 100015, UPC 9 315517 099395, UPC 9 315517 104600, UPC 9 315517 098725 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled Valco Baby Trend Duo Double Stroller and contact Junior Brands Corp for additional information on how to eliminate the hazards. For more information, consumers can contact Junior Brands Corp. by email at support@juniorbrands.ca or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: Hot Hands Rechargeable Hand Warmers Summary product: Hot Hands Rechargeable Hand Warmers Issue: Burn hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Burn hazard Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Kobayashi to obtain a refund. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. records.title: Certain Summerhill Market brand raspberries and raspberry-containing products recalled due to norovirus
productNames: Frozen raspberries, frozen berry mix, frozen smoothie mix, protein power pod raspberry
records.hazard: Food - Microbial contamination - Norovirus
records.remedy: Do not consume, use, sell, serve, or distribute recalled products
records.description: Published by: CFIA Category: Frozen - Other Product: Frozen raspberries, frozen berry mix, frozen smoothie mix, protein power pod raspberry Summary product: Frozen raspberries, frozen berry mix, frozen smoothie mix, protein power pod raspberry Issue: Norovirus Summary issue: Food - Microbial contamination - Norovirus Affected products table entries: 4 Identifiers: UPC 0 56647 15698 3, UPC 0 56647 15706 5, UPC 0 56647 15705 8, UPC 0 56647 16430 8 If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased People with norovirus illness usually develop symptoms of gastroenteritis within 24 to 48 hours, but symptoms can start as early as 12 hours after exposure. The illness often begins suddenly. Even after having the illness, you can still become re-infected by norovirus. The main symptoms of norovirus illness are diarrhea, vomiting (children usually experience more vomiting than adults), nausea and stomach cramps. Other symptoms may include low-grade fever, headache, chills, muscle aches and fatigue (a general sense of tiredness). Most people feel better within one or two days, with symptoms resolving on their own, and experience no long-term health effects. As with any illness causing diarrhea or vomiting, people who are ill should drink plenty of liquids to replace lost body fluids and prevent dehydration. In severe cases, patients may need to be hospitalized and given fluids intravenously. Learn more:Learn more about the health risks Sign up for recall notifications by email and follow us on social media View our detailed explanation of the food safety investigation and recall process Report a food safety or labelling concern

records.title: ​​Certain 3-inch Grundfos SQFlex Solar Submersible Pumps​ recalled due to electric shock hazard
records.hazard: Consumer products - Electrical hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Grundfos or your installer for a repair or replacement.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Other Product: Grundfos 3-inch SQFlex Solar Submersible Pumps Summary product: Grundfos 3-inch SQFlex Solar Submersible Pumps Issue: Electrical hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Electrical hazard Affected products table entries: 5 This recall involves certain 3 inch Grundfos SQFlex Solar Submersible Pumps. The affected products are submersible pumps used to pump groundwater with a built-in inverter that can accept DC power (e.g., solar, wind) or AC power. They are 76 mm (3 inches) in diameter. The model number and date codes can be found on a nameplate on the product, and on the product packaging. Consumers should immediately stop using affected pumps installed on the surface, such as those used in tanks and ponds, and contact Grundfos or your installer for a repair or replacement. Affected pumps that have not been installed yet should be returned for a replacement. For pumps installed in wells, no immediate action is required, but affected pumps should be identified and isolated and Grundfos contacted when the pump is removed from the well for any reason in the future. For more information, consumers can contact Grundfos Canada Inc. by telephone at 1-844-994-2850, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., CST, by email at recall@grundfos.com or visit the company's website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: ​​Galanz Retro Refrigerators​ recalled due to fire and burn hazards
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product, unplug it and contact Galanz to schedule a free in-home repair by a qualified technician.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Appliances Product: Galanz Retro Refrigerators Summary product: Galanz Retro Refrigerators Issue: Fire hazard - Burn hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Galanz Retro refrigerators that are red and measure about 147 cm (58 inches) high, 61 cm (24 inches) deep and 53 cm (21 inches) wide. The 7.6 cu. ft. capacity refrigerators have doors with handles on the left side (please refer to the images above for the handle variations featured on the affected product model), three adjustable glass shelves, one drawer and one glass shelf. The top of the freezer has a separate door, and “Galanz” printed on the front. Only refrigerators with date codes ranging from December 2018 through December 2020 and with the model number GLR76TRDER, are included in this recall. There are two affected sub-models corresponding to this customer model: BCD-215VF-C-62H, and BCD-215VF-D-62H. The relevant UPC codes are 686136919715 and 190873001171. The model number and the date code, in MMYYYY format are printed on a white label on the back of the Galanz Retro Refrigerator. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product, unplug it and go the Galanz website to complete the registration form to schedule a free in-home repair by a qualified technician. For more information, consumers can contact Galanz by telephone at 888-462-0579, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Cambridge Audio Yoyo (M) Portable Bluetooth Speakers recalled due to fire hazard
productNames: Cambridge Audio Yoyo (M) Portable Bluetooth Speakers
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Cambridge Audio to arrange a refund. Consumers should keep the recalled speakers until they receive further instruction from Cambridge Audio.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: Cambridge Audio Yoyo (M) Portable Bluetooth Speakers Summary product: Cambridge Audio Yoyo (M) Portable Bluetooth Speakers Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 3 This recall involves Cambridge Audio Yoyo (M) portable Bluetooth speakers available in dark gray, light gray and blue. They come in a boxed pair of two speakers. Both speakers carry the same FD number. There is no batch number for this product, and every unit is affected, wherever and whenever it was bought. Identifiers: UPC 813371022959, UPC 813371022966, UPC 813371024922, 813371022959, 5055300413055, 813371022966, 5055300413062, 813371024922, 5055300413406 Consumers who have these affected products should immediately stop using them and contact Cambridge Audio to verify if the product is affected by the recall. Consumers should keep the recalled speakers until they receive further instruction from Cambridge Audio. Keep the speakers switched off and unplugged and do not charge them. Store them somewhere cool, dry and out of the way, clear of anything that burns easily (such as paper, cardboard and flammable liquids), and away from radiators, direct sunlight and excessive heat. The refund process can be found at the company's website. Once Cambridge Audio has processed the claim and confirmed a refund, the consumer may dispose of the product safely in such a way that they cannot be used again. Contact your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries. Batteries are considered hazardous waste. Do not place them in household garbage. For more information, consumers can contact Cambridge Audio/Audio Partnership Plc by telephone at 888-805-5001, from 9am to 5pm Eastern Time (ET), Monday to Friday, by email at recall.canada@cambridgeaudio.com or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Certain Char-Broil Bistro Pro™ Electric Grill + Charcoal Mode​ recalled due to potential electric shock hazard
productNames: Char-Broil Bistro Pro™ Electric Grill + Charcoal Mode
records.hazard: Consumer products - Electrical hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Char-Broil to obtain a free repair kit.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Appliances Product: Char-Broil Bistro Pro™ Electric Grill + Charcoal Mode Summary product: Char-Broil Bistro Pro™ Electric Grill + Charcoal Mode Issue: Electrical hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Electrical hazard Affected products table entries: 3 This recall involves Char-Broil Bistro Pro™ Electric Grill + Charcoal Mode manufactured between October and December 2025 with SKU 25302177 and UPC 099143021775. The product label, which identifies the model and serial number (which includes a manufacturing date code), is located on the bottom shelf of full-size grills, and on the side bar of tabletop models. Only products manufactured between October and December 2025 are captured by this recall. The 4-digit date code (in YYMM format) is part of the unit serial number. Identifiers: UPC 099143021775, 25302177, 099143021775 Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Char-Broil to obtain a repair kit. To register for the recall and request a free repair kit, customers should use the online order form at charbroil.com/Bistro Pro Fix. The repair kit consists of instructions for accessing and securing the grounding wire connection, the tools required to perform the repair (long-extension screwdriver and 5/16” (8mm) wrench), and a label to place on the unit to certify that the rework has been performed. A video demonstrating the repair steps is available here: https://www.charbroil.com/2026Bistro Pro Repair Video. Char-Broil is offering a $25 gift card, valid at participating retailers, to consumers who provide documentation of the completed repair. For more information, consumers can contact Char-Broil by telephone at 866-671-7988 from 6 am to 6 pm MT Monday through Saturday, by email at recall@charbroil.com or visit the company website. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Char-Broil. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Finnleo, Tylo, Polar, Radiant Health, and Helo Brand Saunas and Infrared Kits recalled due to fire and burn hazards
productNames: Finnleo, Tylo, Polar, Radiant Health, and Helo Brand Saunas and Infrared Kits
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free in-home repair from a professional installer.​
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Household items Product: Finnleo, Tylo, Polar, Radiant Health, and Helo Brand Saunas and Infrared Kits Summary product: Finnleo, Tylo, Polar, Radiant Health, and Helo Brand Saunas and Infrared Kits Issue: Fire hazard - Burn hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 25 This recall involves Finnleo, Tylo, Polar, Radiant Health, and Helo brand saunas and infrared (“IR”) kits, which were sold separately. The models affected by the recall are the B Series, IG Series, S Series, IS Series, Kiruna, Kiruna Hybrid IS, Pause, Sentinel, Sentinel Hybrid and Elite. Customers who purchased custom rooms built with IR panels can check for the words “Saunalogic,” “Infralogic,” “Carbonflex,” or “Tylö” on their control panel or locate their product manual. Customers who purchased pre-configured IR sauna rooms can identify their product by the brand badge on the front frame panel, the control panel, the manual or the logo handle. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free in-home repair from a professional installer. For more information, consumers can contact Sauna360 by telephone at 1-866-936-5962, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday or by email at recall@sauna360.com. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Sauna360. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

Symptoms can include vomiting, nausea, persistent fever, muscle aches, severe headache and neck stiffness. Pregnant women, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems are particularly at risk. Although infected pregnant women may experience only mild, flu-like symptoms, the infection can lead to premature delivery, infection of the newborn or even stillbirth. In severe cases of illness, people may die. records.title: Alasko brand frozen whole raspberries recalled due to norovirus
records.hazard: Food - Microbial contamination - Norovirus
records.remedy: Do not consume, use, sell, serve, or distribute recalled products
records.description: Published by: CFIA Category: Frozen Product: Frozen whole raspberries Summary product: Frozen whole raspberries Issue: Norovirus Summary issue: Food - Microbial contamination - Norovirus Affected products table entries: 2 Identifiers: UPC 6 95058 00205 4, UPC 1 069505 800205 1, LOT# SY25314, Lot: SY25314 If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased People with norovirus illness usually develop symptoms of gastroenteritis within 24 to 48 hours, but symptoms can start as early as 12 hours after exposure. The illness often begins suddenly. Even after having the illness, you can still become re-infected by norovirus. The main symptoms of norovirus illness are diarrhea, vomiting (children usually experience more vomiting than adults), nausea and stomach cramps. Other symptoms may include low-grade fever, headache, chills, muscle aches and fatigue (a general sense of tiredness). Most people feel better within one or two days, with symptoms resolving on their own, and experience no long-term health effects. As with any illness causing diarrhea or vomiting, people who are ill should drink plenty of liquids to replace lost body fluids and prevent dehydration. In severe cases, patients may need to be hospitalized and given fluids intravenously. records.title: ​​AGA and La Cornue freestanding dual fuel ranges​ recalled due to fire hazard
productNames: AGA and La Cornue freestanding dual fuel ranges
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Consumers should immediately shut off the gas supply to the recalled product and contact AGA Rangemaster Limited to coordinate a free inspection and to obtain subsequent free repair as required.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Appliances Product: AGA and La Cornue freestanding dual fuel ranges Summary product: AGA and La Cornue freestanding dual fuel ranges Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 6 This recall involves the AGA and La Cornue dual fuel range cooking appliances listed in the table below. The recall applies to all colour variations, trim options, burner configurations, and gas types. These appliances feature a gas cooktop compatible with either natural gas or liquid propane (LP) and are equipped with electric ovens. The affected units were manufactured between March 19, 2025 and July 24, 2026. The model, serial number and manufacturing date can be found on the rating plate located on the bottom panel under the storage drawer. To determine if your specific range is included in this recall, go to the recall webpage at lacornueusa.com/testcap-recall or agarangeusa.com/testcap-recall , and enter your model and serial number in the search tool and if your model and serial numbers are found, your range is included in this recall. Consumers should immediately shut off the gas supply to the recalled product and contact AGA Rangemaster Limited to coordinate a free inspection and to obtain subsequent free repair as required. Consumers can continue to use the electric oven sections of the range. For more information, consumers can contact AGA Rangemaster by telephone toll-free at 1-888-257-7912, 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday, or visit the company website at lacornueusa.com or agarangeusa.com, and click on “Recall Information” at the bottom of the page. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and AGA Rangemaster Limited. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Amana Through the Wall (TTW) air conditioners or heat pumps recalled due to fire hazard
productNames: Amana Through the Wall (TTW) air conditioners or heat pumps
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Daikin Comfort Technologies.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Specialized products Product: Amana Through the Wall (TTW) air conditioners or heat pumps Summary product: Amana Through the Wall (TTW) air conditioners or heat pumps Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 4 This recall involves certain models of Amana brand Through-the-Wall Air Conditioners or Heat Pumps. The affected products are white-coloured and the brand name, Amana, is printed on most of the units' control covers. The units are used to provide room climate control. The model number is located on the front of the unit on the front edge of the base pan on a white sticker. It will have the model beginning with PB** and the serial number is under the bar code that is under the model number. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled Amana Through-the-Wall Air Conditioners or Heat Pumps and contact Daikin Comfort Technologies to submit a request for a full refund of the unit. For more information, consumers can contact Daikin Comfort Technologies by telephone toll-free at 833-730-0939 between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. CT or by visiting the company website. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Daikin Comfort Technologies. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Branch Ergonomic Chairs recalled due to fall hazard
productNames: Ergonomic Chair – Light Blue / White Standard
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fall hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Branch for a free repair kit.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Furniture and furnishings Product: Ergonomic Chairs Summary product: Ergonomic Chairs Issue: Fall hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fall hazard Affected products table entries: 3 This recall involves height-adjustable Branch ergonomic chairs and only applies to chairs with backrest anchors that were incorrectly installed at the time of manufacture. The recalled chairs were manufactured between September 10, 2025 and April 22, 2026. The dates of manufacture can be found on the label located underneath the chair’s seat cushion. The following SKUs are included in the recall and are located on the side of the product packaging. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled chairs and contact Branch for a free repair kit consisting of a replacement backrest, installation instructions, three bolts and an Allen key. Consumers will be provided with instructions on how to determine if their backrests are included in the recall and will be asked to submit photos of the manufacture label and removed backrest to obtain a repair kit. Branch is contacting all known purchasers directly. For more information, consumers can contact Branch by email at customersupport@branchfurniture.com or visit the company website at branchfurniture.com/recall or branchfurniture.com and click on “Recall Information” in the Support section at the bottom of the page for more information. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Branch. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact OCOOPA Direct for a full refund. Dispose of it by contacting your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Electronics Product: OCOOPA Rechargeable Hand Warmers Summary product: OCOOPA Rechargeable Hand Warmers Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Consumers should stop using the recalled hand warmers immediately and contact OCOOPA Direct for a full refund in the form of an OCOOPA gift card or the original form of payment. Consumers should safely dispose of the items in such a way that they cannot be used again. Contact your municipality for instructions on how to safely transport and dispose of lithium-ion batteries. Batteries are considered hazardous waste. Do not place them in household garbage. For more information, consumers can contact OCOOPA Direct by email at ocooparecalls@ocoopa.cc or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. records.title: ​​Hustler or Big Dog LED Light Kits and Light Bars ​recalled due to fire hazard
productNames: Hustler or Big Dog LED Light Kits and Light Bars
records.hazard: Consumer products - Fire hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact their point-of-sale dealer for a refund.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Tools and accessories Product: Hustler or Big Dog LED Light Kits and Light Bars Summary product: Hustler or Big Dog LED Light Kits and Light Bars Issue: Fire hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Fire hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Hustler and Big Dog brand LED Light Kits and Light Bars sold as an OEM accessory for residential and commercial ride-on mowing equipment. Each kit contains two LED Light Bars, a wiring harness, a metal mounting plate and a light switch (if equipped). Configurations vary by model. The LED Light Bars could have been sold separately without the kit. Identifiers: Part Number 605003, Part Number 121482, 121505, 126991, 126992, 126995, 126999, 127057, 127057P, 127928, 127928P Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact the selling dealer. Affected consumers should unplug the LED Light Bars to eliminate the hazard and have their dealer uninstall the LED Light Kit and destroy the light bars free of charge. records.title: Workbless Electric Pressure Washers recalled due to electric shock hazard
productNames: Workbless Heavy Duty Electric Pressure Washer
records.hazard: Consumer products - Electrical hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled products and contact Guangzhou Ao Lian Ya Wang Luo Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si for a full refund.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Tools and accessories Product: Workbless Electric Pressure Washers Summary product: Workbless Electric Pressure Washers Issue: Electrical hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Electrical hazard Affected products table entries: 2 This recall involves Workbless-branded pressure washers, models WB0301 and WB0302. Model WB0301 is green and black and measures about 27.24 inches (69 cm) high, 10.83 inches (27.5 cm) wide and 8.39 inches (21 cm) deep. “WORKBLESS”, "WB0301” and “ELECTRIC PRESSURE WASHER” are printed on a label on the back of the pressure washer. Model WB0302 is also green and black and measures about 29.57 inches (75 cm) high, 14.69 inches (37 cm) wide and 10.94 (28 cm) inches deep. “WORKBLESS”, “WB0302” and “HEAVY DUTY ELECTRIC PRESSURE WASHER” are printed on a label on the back of the pressure washer. Both models came with four quick connect nozzles and a foam cannon. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Guangzhou Ao Lian Ya Wang Luo Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed pressure washer to Guangzhou Ao Lian Ya Wang Luo Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product according to local municipal guidelines. For more information, consumers can contact Guangzhou Ao Lian Ya Wang Luo Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si by telephone at 1-833-725-3151 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. PT, Monday through Friday by email at service@workbless.net or visit the company website. Joint recall with Health Canada, the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (US CPSC) and Guangzhou Ao Lian Ya Wang Luo Ke Ji You Xian Gong Si. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.
records.reason: Consumer products - Electrical hazard
