records.title: Two lots of Teva-Pregabalin 150 mg capsules recalled due to cross-contamination with the drug sertraline
records.hazard: Health products - Contamination
records.remedy: If you experience a serious allergic reaction (anaphylaxis), stop taking the affected product and seek immediate medical help by calling 9-1-1. Otherwise, do not stop taking your pregabalin medication without first speaking with your healthcare professional or pharmacist, as stopping suddenly may cause withdrawal symptoms. Return the product to the pharmacy where it was purchased as soon as possible for a replacement or alternative supply, and for proper disposal. If you are unsure whether your product is recalled, check with your pharmacy.
records.description: Published by: Communications and Public Affairs Branch Category: Drugs Product: Teva-Pregabalin 150 mg capsules Summary product: Teva-Pregabalin 150 mg capsules Issue: Contamination Summary issue: Health products - Contamination Affected products table entries: 1 Identifiers: 02361205, 100070495, 100068913 If you experience a serious allergic reaction (anaphylaxis), stop taking the affected product and seek immediate medical help by calling 9-1-1. Otherwise, do not stop taking your pregabalin medication without first speaking with your healthcare professional or pharmacist, as stopping suddenly may cause withdrawal symptoms including insomnia, nausea, headache, anxiety, excessive sweating, diarrhea, and convulsions. Return the product to the pharmacy where it was purchased as soon as possible for a replacement or alternative supply, and for proper disposal. If you are unsure whether your product is recalled, check with your pharmacy. Seek medical attention if you have used this product and think you are experiencing side effects. Contact Teva Canada Customer Care by calling toll-free at 1-800-268-4129 or by email at customer.service@tevacanada.com, if you have questions about this recall. Report any health product-related side effects or complaints to Health Canada.

productNames: Country-Style Pâté, Duck Liver Mousse with Port, Liver Pâté with Cognac
records.hazard: Food - Microbial contamination - Listeria
records.remedy: Do not consume, use, sell, serve, or distribute recalled products
records.description: Published by: CFIA Category: Processed Product: Country-Style Pâté, Duck Liver Mousse with Port, Liver Pâté with Cognac Summary product: Country-Style Pâté, Duck Liver Mousse with Port, Liver Pâté with Cognac Issue: Listeria Summary issue: Food - Microbial contamination - Listeria Affected products table entries: 3 Identifiers: UPC 6 28872 50101 4, UPC 6 28872 50301 8, UPC 6 28872 50004 8 If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased Food contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick. Symptoms can include vomiting, nausea, persistent fever, muscle aches, severe headache and neck stiffness. Pregnant women, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems are particularly at risk. Although infected pregnant women may experience only mild, flu-like symptoms, the infection can lead to premature delivery, infection of the newborn or even stillbirth. In severe cases of illness, people may die. records.title: Madewell Double V-Neck Pullover and V-Neck Cardigan Sweaters recalled due to flammability hazard
productNames: Madewell Double V-Neck Pullover and V-Neck Cardigan Sweaters
records.hazard: Consumer products - Flammability hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Madewell for a store credit or refund. See details below.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Clothing Product: Madewell Double V-Neck Pullover and V-Neck Cardigan Sweaters Summary product: Madewell Double V-Neck Pullover and V-Neck Cardigan Sweaters Issue: Flammability hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Flammability hazard Consumers should immediately stop wearing the recalled sweaters and contact Madewell for a refund of the original purchase price or equivalent store credit. Consumers will be asked to destroy the sweater by cutting it in half. Consumers must provide their name, address, telephone number, email address, affected product information, order number (if available), a photograph of the product label showing the style number and HO24 code, and a photograph of the sweater cut in half. Consumers should also indicate whether they prefer a refund of the original purchase price or equivalent store credit. For more information, consumers can contact Madewell by telephone at 1-866-544-1937, from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. EST, Monday through Sunday, by email at 24-7@madewell.com or on the company's website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Warn® wireless remote kit for truck and utility winches recalled due to failure to operate
productNames: Warn® wireless remote kit for truck and utility winches
records.hazard: Consumer products - Injury hazard
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the recalled product and contact WARN Industries, Inc. for a refund.
records.description: Published by: Consumer product safety Category: Tools and accessories Product: Warn® wireless remote kit for truck and utility winches Summary product: Warn® wireless remote kit for truck and utility winches Issue: Injury hazard Summary issue: Consumer products - Injury hazard Affected products table entries: 11 This recall involves Warn® Wireless Remote Kit for Truck and Utility Winches, PN 90287. The two pieces, a transmitter and a receiver, are black and red in color and each piece has a prominent WARN emblem. Date codes affected are after 5023 (format WWYY). Product functionality is only adversely affected when used with some legacy model winches, as identified in WARN’s Non-Compatibility List below. Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product with non-compatible legacy model winches and contact WARN Industries, Inc. for a refund. WARN Industries will provide a refund for part number 90287 to customers who purchased these remote-control products for use with a winch identified on WARN's Non-Compatibility List. For more information, consumers can contact WARN Industries, Inc. by telephone at 1-800-543-9276, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. PT, Monday to Friday by email at cs@warn.com or visit the company website. Please note that the Canada Consumer Product Safety Act prohibits recalled products from being redistributed, sold or even given away in Canada. Health Canada would like to remind consumers to report any health or safety incidents related to the use of this product or any other consumer product or cosmetic by filling out the Consumer Product Incident Report Form. This recall is also posted on the OECD Global Portal on Product Recalls website. You can visit this site for more information on other international consumer product recalls.

records.title: Unauthorized injectable health products sold online and seized from Dyosa Beauty & Wellness Lounge in Hamilton, ON, may pose serious health risks
records.hazard: Unauthorized product
records.remedy: Do not buy or use unauthorized health products. Consult with a licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse practitioner, pharmacist) if you think you may have been administered these products at Dyosa Beauty & Wellness Lounge, or at any other location, and have health concerns. When receiving injectable treatments, ask your healthcare professional to show you the product label and verify that the product has been authorized by Health Canada. Authorized health products have an eight-digit Drug Identification Number (DIN), Natural Product Number (NPN) or Homeopathic Drug Number (DIN-HM). You can also check whether products are authorized for sale by searching Health Canada's Drug Product Database or Licensed Natural Health Products Database. Report any health product-related side effects or complaints, including suspected counterfeits, to Health Canada. You can also contact the manufacturer directly to confirm a product's authenticity.

records.title: Coaticook brand White Cheddar cheeses recalled due to Listeria monocytogenes
records.hazard: Listeria
records.remedy: If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased Food contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick. Symptoms can include vomiting, nausea, persistent fever, muscle aches, severe headache and neck stiffness. Pregnant women, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems are particularly at risk. Although infected pregnant women may experience only mild, flu-like symptoms, the infection can lead to premature delivery, infection of the newborn or even stillbirth. In severe cases of illness, people may die. records.title: Various brands of meat products recalled due to Listeria monocytogenes
records.hazard: Listeria
records.remedy: If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased Food contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick. Symptoms can include vomiting, nausea, persistent fever, muscle aches, severe headache and neck stiffness. Pregnant women, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems are particularly at risk. Although infected pregnant women may experience only mild, flu-like symptoms, the infection can lead to premature delivery, infection of the newborn or even stillbirth. In severe cases of illness, people may die. records.hazard: Listeria
records.remedy: If you think you became sick from consuming a recalled product, contact your healthcare provider Check to see if you have recalled products Do not consume, serve, use, sell, or distribute recalled products Recalled products should be thrown out or returned to the location where they were purchased Food contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick. Symptoms can include vomiting, nausea, persistent fever, muscle aches, severe headache and neck stiffness. Pregnant women, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems are particularly at risk. Although infected pregnant women may experience only mild, flu-like symptoms, the infection can lead to premature delivery, infection of the newborn or even stillbirth. In severe cases of illness, people may die. productNames: Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-In-1 Gas Grills with Pizza Oven
records.hazard: Laceration hazard
records.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Conair for a refund. Consumers should stop using the recalled Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-in-1 Gas Grill immediately and visit Conair’s website to check if their grill is included in the recall. If affected, follow the instructions to safely remove the tempered glass window on the pizza oven and upload two photographs; one of the removed glass and one of the grill’s serial number to the firm’s website. Upon verification, consumers will receive a $500 USD refund by check or be reimbursed for the original purchase amount with proof of receipt. After receiving their refund, consumers should write the word “Recall” with black sharpie marker on the tempered glass and dispose of it. For more information, consumers can contact Conair toll-free at 833-408-0463 from 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET Monday through Friday or online at https://www.recallrtr.com/3in1grill or www.cuisinart.com and click on “Safety Recalls” at the bottom of the page. records.title: Massage pillow - Safety Gate alert

Lead poses a risk to the environment. DEHP and DBP pose a risk to human health and the environment. SCCPs persist in the environment, are toxic to aquatic organisms at low concentrations and bio-accumulate in wildlife and humans, posing a risk to human health and the environment. records.title: Neptune - Aftershave lotion - Safety Gate alert
records.hazard: The product contains benzyl alcohol but the presence is not indicated in the list of ingredients. Consumers are not aware of its presence and may suffer allergic reactions or skin sensitisation. Moreover, the product also contains allergenic fragrances (Linalool, Limonene, Citral, Geraniol and Farnesol), which are not mentioned in the list of ingredients. Failure to mention the presence of these allergenic substances on the labelling in leave-on products may cause dermatitis/eczema, or more serious skin reactions in already sensitized persons.

records.title: Hotel Chocolat recalls several chocolate products because of the possible presence of Salmonella
records.hazard: The possible presence of Salmonella in the products listed above. Symptoms caused by salmonella usually include fever, diarrhoea and abdominal cramps. If you are experiencing these symptoms, you should stay away from work, school or nursery until you have stopped having symptoms for at least 48 hours to avoid passing it on to others.
records.remedy: If you have bought any of the above products (purchased between 02/10/2026 and 08/10/2026), do not eat them. records.hazard: The presence of Listeria monocytogenes in the products listed above. Symptoms caused by Listeria monocytogenes can be similar to flu and include high temperature, muscle ache or pain, chills, feeling or being sick and diarrhoea. However, in rare cases, the infection can be more severe, causing serious complications, such as meningitis. Some people are more vulnerable to listeria infections, including those over 65 years of age, pregnant women and their unborn babies, babies less than one month old and people with weakened immune systems.

records.title: Food Alert For Action: To food businesses and consumers who have purchased shell eggs originating from Yasensvit Ltd, Ukraine, stamped with the code 3UA1012066
productNames: The establishment: Yasensvit Ltd, Kyiv, Ukraine
Raw shell-on eggs - Product Code 3UA1012066 / All sizes / All dates
records.hazard: The possible presence of Salmonella in the product listed above. Symptoms caused by Salmonella usually include fever, diarrhoea and abdominal cramps. If you are experiencing these symptoms, you should stay away from work, school or nursery until you have stopped having symptoms for at least 48 hours to avoid passing it on to others. Advice for businesses: Food businesses should check their egg supply chain and the codes stamped on eggs within their control. It is possible eggs with this code originating from Yasensvit Ltd, Kyiv, Ukraine, may have been repacked by other businesses in the UK and have different business details and packing centre codes detailed on the outer packaging. Businesses are advised to immediately stop using or selling eggs with the stamp 3UA1012066, undertake product withdrawals, and where there have been retail sales, to undertake product recalls. If you have been supplied with these eggs, dispose of them safely. These eggs should not be diverted to further processing.
records.remedy: Consumers should check the code stamped on the egg; do not eat eggs stamped with 3UA1012066. Instead, dispose of them at home. These eggs are not sold in large retailers, like supermarkets. Most are used within the catering supply chain; however, some eggs may also be sold at small shops such as corner shops. We are asking enforcement authorities to ensure that businesses who have received the affected eggs take action to ensure that these are withdrawn from the market and, where there have been retail sales, recalled. We are also asking the local authorities to inform the FSA of product withdrawal and recall actions.

Advice for businesses:
Food businesses should check their egg supply chain and the codes stamped on eggs within their control. It is possible eggs with this code originating from Yasensvit Ltd, Kyiv, Ukraine, may have been repacked by other businesses in the UK and have different business details and packing centre codes detailed on the outer packaging. Businesses are advised to immediately stop using or selling eggs with the stamp 3UA1012066, undertake product withdrawals, and where there have been retail sales, to undertake product recalls. If you have been supplied with these eggs, dispose of them safely. These eggs should not be diverted to further processing.

records.hazard: The presence of Listeria monocytogenes in the product listed above. Symptoms caused by Listeria monocytogenes can be similar to flu and include high temperature, muscle ache or pain, chills, feeling or being sick and diarrhoea. records.title: Macroom Buffalo Cheese Products recalls Macroom Buffalo Cheese Mozzarella and Macroom Buffalo Cheese Bocconcini because of contamination with Listeria monocytogenes
records.hazard: The presence of Listeria monocytogenes in the products listed above. Symptoms caused by Listeria monocytogenes can be similar to flu and include high temperature, muscle ache or pain, chills, feeling or being sick and diarrhoea. However, in rare cases, the infection can be more severe, causing serious complications, such as meningitis. Some people are more vulnerable to listeria infections, including those over 65 years of age, pregnant women and their unborn babies, babies less than one month old and people with weakened immune systems.

records.title: M&S recalls M&S Food Truffle Gouda due to the presence of Listeria Monocytogenes
records.hazard: The presence of Listeria monocytogenes in the product listed in the table above. Symptoms caused by Listeria monocytogenes can be similar to flu and include high temperature, muscle ache or pain, chills, feeling or being sick and diarrhoea. However, in rare cases, the infection can be more severe, causing serious complications, such as meningitis. Some people are more vulnerable to listeria infections, including those over 65 years of age, pregnant women and their unborn babies, babies less than one month old and people with weakened immune systems.

records.title: Halloween themed light-up clickers
brandNames: Kent Road Public School P&C Association
productNames: Multi coloured Halloween themed light-up clickers with keychains in the following designs: White ghost Rainbow ghost Orange pumpkin Glitter orange pumpkin White dumpling Rainbow dumpling The products contain a button/coin battery. The products were sold online and at/outside school premises on several occasions in the lead-up to the P&C Halloween Dance on 29 October 2026.
records.hazard: Children are at risk of choking, severe internal burn injuries or death if they swallow or place button/coin batteries inside their bodies. Serious injury can occur in as little as 2 hours and the results can be fatal. In Australia, children have suffered serious injuries or died from swallowing button/coin batteries. If you suspect a child has swallowed or inserted a button/coin battery: Call Triple Zero (000) if a child is having any difficulty breathing. Call the Poisons Information Centre immediately on 13 11 26, available 24 hours a day. They can direct you to an appropriate medical facility. Early action can save lives. Do not wait for symptoms to develop.
records.remedy: Stop using the product immediately and keep out of reach of children. Return the product to Kent Road Public School office for a full refund. For further assistance with this recall, contact Kent Road Public School P&C Association.
records.description: Product: Multi coloured Halloween themed light-up clickers with keychains in the following designs: White ghost Rainbow ghost Orange pumpkin Glitter orange pumpkin White dumpling Rainbow dumpling The products contain a button/coin battery. records.title: S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit
productNames: Portable waterless dry flush toilet designed for campervans, caravans, motorhomes, boats and off-grid cabins. The toilet has a motorised mechanism powered by a rechargeable lithium-ion battery to seal waste into bags. The adapter kit provides the same lithium-ion battery powered mechanism for use with other CompoCloset toilets.
S1 Dry Flush Sealing Toilet and S1 Adapter Kit
records.hazard: Risk of serious injury, death, and/or property damage if damaged batteries overheat, release smoke and toxic gas or catch fire.
records.remedy: If the battery has been charged at temperatures under 3°C or if you are unsure: immediately stop using the affected toilets and adapter kits disconnect the lithium-ion battery from its power source and remove the battery from the toilet or the adapter kit. If you need help disconnecting and removing the battery, contact Compo Closet Ltd. If the battery has not been charged at or will not be exposed to temperatures below 3°C, you can continue to use the affected toilet or adapter kit until you receive a replacement battery. Check with your local government about requirements for disposal of the affected lithium-ion battery. Do not place the batteries in household rubbish, recycling bins or battery bins at shops. Compo Closet Ltd will provide a free replacement battery with cold charging protection for all affected consumers, expected to be available in December 2026. Consumers can also request a free bypass cable that will allow the toilet to operate using a 12V vehicle or boat battery. Complete the Notice Confirmation Form at to arrange for a free replacement battery and/or a 12V bypass cable.

records.title: Basco BFO-15671 oil filter for diesel engines
productNames: Spin-on engine oil filter for diesel engines, sold as both a standalone part and as part of service kits. Suitable for the following vehicles: Isuzu D-Max (TFR/TFS series, 06/2012-2026) Isuzu MU-X (UCS85, 11/2013-06/2021) Isuzu MU-X (UCR40/UCS40, 07/2021-2026) Mazda BT50 (B30 TFR40/TFS40, 08/2020-2026) with 3.0L diesel 4JJ1-TCX or 4JJ3-TCX engines Standalone oil filter (sold at Basco Wholesale and Allied Auto Online): Part number BFO-15671 (found on packaging and filter can) Barcode 9356247149707 Filter service kit containing affected oil filter (sold at Bunnings Warehouse): Kit number BUNF5 Barcode 9356247157535
Basco BFO-15671 oil filter for diesel engines
records.hazard: Risk of death, serious injury or property damage (including to other road users) from an accident if the filter loosens or comes off the engine while the vehicle is being driven. The oil spill from the engine may cause a fire if it comes into contact with the hot engine parts. An incident causing oil loss to a vehicle has occurred.
records.remedy: Stop driving the vehicle immediately if you have the oil filter installed and do not use your vehicle until the oil filter is replaced. If you have not yet fitted the oil filter, do not install it. If the oil filter has been installed in your vehicle, Basco will cover the reasonable costs of having your vehicle inspected and oil filter replaced. Please provide your receipts to Basco when you contact them. If the oil filter has not been installed yet: If you purchased the standalone oil filter from Basco or Allied Auto, contact Basco to arrange a free replacement or full refund, If you purchased the filter service kit from Bunnings, return the kit to any Bunnings store for a full refund, or contact Basco to arrange a free replacement oil filter. Contact Basco for further information or assistance with this recall.

records.title: Babybee toddler board with detachable seat
productNames: The Babybee toddler board is a stroller accessory that can be used as a standing toddler board or with a detachable seat. Only the detachable seat is recalled. The toddler board itself is not affected. The toddler boards with the affected detachable seat have batch numbers X-001, X-002, X-012A and X-015D. These can be found on the underside of the toddler board.
Babybee toddler board with detachable seat
records.hazard: Risk of serious injury to a child from a fall if the detachable seat breaks while in use. Incidents have occurred.
records.remedy: Stop using the toddler board immediately and check the batch number on the underside of your Babybee toddler board. If your toddler board has batch number X-001, X-002, X-012A or X-015D, remove the detachable seat from the toddler board. The toddler board may continue to be used in standing mode without the detachable seat. Dispose of the affected detachable seat in your household general waste bin. Register your affected product at: Babybee will provide affected consumers with a replacement detachable seat free of charge. Replacement seats are expected to be available from approximately early October 2026. Registered consumers will be contacted when replacement seats are ready for dispatch and will receive updates if this timing changes. Contact Babybee if you require further information or assistance with this recall.

If you suspect a child has swallowed or inserted a button or coin battery: Call Triple Zero (000) if your child is bleeding or having any difficulty breathing. Call the Poisons Information Centre immediately on 13 11 26, available 24 hours a day. They can direct you to an appropriate medical facility. Early action can save lives. Do not wait for symptoms to develop.

Westinghouse Chest Freezer Product models WCM5000WE and WCM7000WE with serial number ranges 62580532 to 63890596 only - sold at various retailers.
records.hazard: Electrolux (NZ) Limited, is recalling Westinghouse Chest Freezers 500L and 702L models (WCM5000WE and WCM7000WE). The affected products are those with serial number ranges 62580532 to 63890596 only. The model and serial number is visible on the upper portion of the right-hand side panel of the appliance (as shown in the side view image). The product does not comply with the relevant standard (Clause 22.112 of AS/NZS 60335.2.24) and may pose a potential safety risk as the force required to open the door of the product may exceed the requirement of the standard. A child may not be able to open the door from the inside of the freezer if they enter the unit and become entrapped. This could result in serious injury or death from suffocation.
records.remedy: Consumers should check the model number and serial number of the freezer to see if it is affected. If their freezer is an affected model consumers should call Electrolux customer care on 0800 277 542 to arrange for a free service appointment to have the product repaired. In the meantime, children should be kept away from the freezer and not allowed to access it.

records.hazard: Faber-Castell is recalling the Creativity for Kids Terrarium because a recent sample of sand from this range has returned a positive test for asbestos. The latest Health NZ advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Email sales.nz10@faber-castell.com with proof of purchase such as a receipt or photo of the product for a refund. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

Theragun G4PRO Charger sold at various retailers
records.hazard: Therabody, Inc. is recalling the Theragun G4PRO Charger. The affected Theragun G4PRO chargers may overheat while charging the device’s removable battery pack, presenting the risk of a potential thermal event. There is a risk of fire, injury and damage if a thermal event occurs.
records.remedy: Immediately stop using the affected charger and unplug it. Do not use it to charge the removable battery pack. Keep the charger out of reach of children. Register the affected charger at the Theragun G4PRO Charger recall registration portal to receive a replacement when one becomes available. Upload photographs of the charger for validation as instructed. Do not dispose of the affected charger until you have contacted Therabody and received instructions about the replacement process. Once instructed, dispose of the charger in accordance with local requirements. The date the replacement charger will become available has not yet been confirmed. The Theragun G4PRO massage device, removable battery pack and power cord are not affected. These can be kept for use with the replacement charger. The massage device may continue to be used and can be charged using an alternative method, such as a wireless charger.

records.hazard: Faber-Castell is recalling the Creativity for Kids: Plant & Grow Woodland Forest product because trace elements of asbestos have been found in the orange sand contained inside this craft kit. The latest Health NZ advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Email sales.nz10@faber-castell.com with proof of purchase such as a receipt or photo of the product for a refund. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

detail.hazard: Faber-Castell is recalling the Creativity for Kids: Plant & Grow Woodland Forest product because trace elements of asbestos have been found in the orange sand contained inside this craft kit. The latest Health NZ advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
detail.action: Stop using the products immediately. Email sales.nz10@faber-castell.com with proof of purchase such as a receipt or photo of the product for a refund. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 to discuss any health concerns you may have. records.title: University of Auckland Graduation Bears sold at the Campus Bookstore at the University of Auckland
productNames: University of Auckland Graduation Bears Potentially affected Graduation Bears sold at the Campus Bookstore at the University of Auckland from 3 August 2026 to 28 September 2026. The recall applies only to the three bear styles shown above that have a removable graduation trencher secured with an elastic chinstrap. Boop Bear: 91313 Graduation Bear: 81179 Graduation Bear 23cm: 81171 The affected bears are dressed in a graduation gown and have a removable graduation trencher This recall does not apply to the standard graduation bear where the trencher is stitched securely to the bear.
University of Auckland Graduation Bears sold at the Campus Bookstore at the University of Auckland
records.hazard: Antics Marketing Limited is recalling the three affected University of Auckland Graduation Bears because the elastic chinstrap attached to the removable trencher may not meet applicable toy safety requirements for cord and strap length. The chinstrap may present an entanglement or strangulation hazard.
records.remedy: Stop using the removable graduation trencher immediately and return the affected bear to the University of Auckland. Customers may choose either a refund or a fully tested replacement graduation bear at no cost. The replacement is the standard graduation bear with the gown and trencher securely attached. For further information or to arrange a return, refund or replacement, please email campusstore@auckland.ac.nz or visit the Campus Store from 10am–3pm.

records.title: 4 button clickable toy on key chain - Provided as a free gift by Kingdomcity
productNames: Novelty key chain with four keyboard-style buttons that light up when pressed. The four buttons on the clickable toy are the letters S O N and a crown image. Given as a free gift by Kingdomcity on 6 September 2026.
4 button clickable toy on key chain - Provided as a free gift by Kingdomcity
records.hazard: Kingdomcity New Zealand Trust is recalling the 4 button clickable toy on key chain because the button battery inside the product is not properly secured and may be accessible to children. Pairs of coloured contact lenses - sold on SHEIN NZ Website
records.hazard: A sample of these contact lenses tested positive for Burkholderia cepacia complex, a bacterial contaminant detected in the solution in which the lenses were packaged. Exposure to this bacterium may pose a risk of eye infection or irritation and an incident was reported in the United Kingdom involving a user who developed an eye infection.
records.remedy: Stop using this product immediately. Do not wear these contact lenses. There is no need to return the product. Please dispose of it safely. SHEIN will be in contact directly with owners of this product to provide a full refund to the original payment method. Please read the notice and click “Yes, confirm” to acknowledge receipt and accept your refund. Your response is important and will assist SHEIN in ensuring that all affected products are accounted for. If you experience any eye symptoms, including redness, pain, discharge or blurred vision after wearing these contact lenses, please seek medical advice promptly. For any questions regarding this recall or if you don't receive direct contact, please contact: nzcsteam@shein.com

records.hazard: New Zealand Health Association Limited (trading as Sanitarium Health Food Company) is recalling this product because it does not include the red fire hazard warning label. records.remedy: Immediately stop wearing the blanket. Consumers should contact Sanitarium to return the product for a full refund. This label is required under the children's nightwear mandatory standard. There is a risk of serious burn injuries if the blanket is exposed to a heat or flame source. Consumers may not be aware of that risk without the label. Immediately stop wearing the blanket. Consumers should contact Sanitarium to return the product for a full refund. For the purposes of this recall, Sanitarium will accept a return of any size Weet-Bix wearable blanket (whether purchased as a ‘Kids’ or ‘Adults’). If unsure, please contact us.

records.title: Legrand Residual Current Circuit Breaker (safety switch): RX3 RCCB 63A 30mA Type A 2P - sold through trade channels
productNames: Legrand Residual Current Circuit Breaker (safety switch): Legrand, RX3 RCCB 63A 30mA Type A 2P Product Code: LG-402038 Batch Date Code: 24W24 The batch marking (24W24) appears on the left side panel of the unit. The product detail markings on the rear of the unit further indicate whether it is from the affected batch. On the packaging, look for batch date code 24W24 on the product box without a green dot — if a green dot is present, the product has been checked and the unit is not faulty. Sold via Trade channel distributors and licensed electrical installers from 17 December 2024 to 15 June 2026.
Legrand Residual Current Circuit Breaker (safety switch): RX3 RCCB 63A 30mA Type A 2P - sold through trade channels
records.hazard: Legrand is recalling the Residual Current Circuit Breaker (safety switch): RX3 RCCB 63A 30mA Type A 2P because of a risk of electric shock and electrocution. An affected unit may fail to trip in response to certain types of fault current (specifically, pulsating DC residual currents), meaning it may not provide the level of electrocution protection indicated by its markings. This is due to a mixed-batch manufacturing issue. Affected units are internally coded as 100mA Type AC rather than 30mA Type A as marked, providing tripping only for residual sinusoidal alternating current, not for residual pulsating DC currents as required.
records.remedy: Electrical professionals should test with an external RCD tester — this is the only reliable field method for confirming whether a unit is affected. Do not use the integrated test button. A faulty unit will fail to trip at 30mA when tested with an external RCD tester. Ensure the test settings are set to 30mA type A. If you are uncertain whether a unit is affected, treat it as affected. If your unit is affected, contact Legrand and let them know. Once they have identified the full extent of affected units through distributor and installer records and responses to the public Recall Notice, Legrand will collect all potentially affected units and provide replacements at its own cost. The remedy is a free replacement of affected units.

An affected unit may fail to trip in response to certain types of fault current (specifically, pulsating DC residual currents), meaning it may not provide the level of electrocution protection indicated by its markings. This is due to a mixed-batch manufacturing issue. Affected units are internally coded as 100mA Type AC rather than 30mA Type A as marked, providing tripping only for residual sinusoidal alternating current, not for residual pulsating DC currents as required.
detail.action: Electrical professionals should test with an external RCD tester — this is the only reliable field method for confirming whether a unit is affected. Do not use the integrated test button. A faulty unit will fail to trip at 30mA when tested with an external RCD tester. Ensure the test settings are set to 30mA type A. If you are uncertain whether a unit is affected, treat it as affected. If your unit is affected, contact Legrand and let them know. Once they have identified the full extent of affected units through distributor and installer records and responses to the public Recall Notice, Legrand will collect all potentially affected units and provide replacements at its own cost. The remedy is a free replacement of affected units.

records.hazard: Hoyts Cinemas is recalling this product because it poses a choking hazard. Some of the character toppers have been identified as having a manufacturing defect which may result in the characters breaking if dropped, pulled or twisted. Children are at risk of choking if small broken parts are placed in the mouth.
records.remedy: If you suspect a child has ingested a small broken part, or if a child is having difficulty breathing, call Emergency Services (111) or go to the nearest hospital emergency room for medical treatment straight away. Immediately discontinue use of the character topper and lid and either dispose of them or return them to Hoyts Cinemas New Zealand, as below. Note that the cups themselves are not defective and do not pose any risk, so can continue to be used. Either: a. Contact Hoyts Cinemas New Zealand using the contact details on this notice to arrange for the product to be returned for a full refund. b. Visit any Hoyts Cinema in New Zealand to return the product for a full refund. If you have already disposed of the character topper or given it (or the whole cup) to another person, please contact that person to advise them of the recall.

records.title: Not to consume batch of bottled apple juice drink with patulin concentration exceeding legal limit
productNames: Not to consume batch of bottled apple juice drink with patulin concentration exceeding legal limit
records.hazard: The CFS collected the above-mentioned sample at a wholesale market in Sai Ying Pun for testing under its routine Food Surveillance Programme. The test result showed that the sample contained patulin at a level of 79 micrograms per kilogram, exceeding the legal limit of 50 mcg per kg of the food. According to the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations (Cap. 132AF), any person who sells apple juice or other beverages to which apple juice has been added, with patulin concentration exceeding the legal limit, commits an offence. Patulin mostly occurs in rotten apples and their products. Animal studies have shown that ingesting high doses of patulin can induce liver, spleen and kidney damage, as well as toxicity to the immune system. For humans, nausea, gastrointestinal disturbances and vomiting have been reported.

According to the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations (Cap. 132AF), muscle of poultry sold in Hong Kong for human consumption is not allowed to contain doxycycline exceeding 100 micrograms per kilogram of the food. Offenders will be prosecuted and will be liable to a fine of $50,000 and imprisonment for six months upon conviction.

The test result showed that the sample contained doxycycline at a level of 180 parts per billion (ppb), exceeding the legal limit of 100 ppb. According to the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations (Cap. 132AF), muscle of poultry sold in Hong Kong for human consumption is not allowed to contain doxycycline exceeding 100 micrograms per kilogram of the food. Offenders will be prosecuted and will be liable to a fine of $50,000 and imprisonment for six months upon conviction. records.title: CFS finds excessive Bacillus cereus in sample of preserved bean curd

records.hazard: The CFS collected the above-mentioned sample from a retailer in Shum Shui Po for testing under its routine Food Surveillance Programme. The test result showed that the sample contained Bacillus cereus at a level of 140 000 per gram. According to the Microbiological Guidelines for Food, if ready-to-eat food contains Bacillus cereus at a level of more than 100 000 per gram, it is considered unsatisfactory. Bacillus cereus is commonly found in the environment. Unhygienic conditions in food processing and storage may give rise to its growth. Consuming food contaminated with excessive Bacillus cereus or its heat-stable toxins may cause gastrointestinal upset such as vomiting and diarrhoea.

records.title: Prepackaged bamboo shoot sample in breach of food labelling regulation
productNames: Prepackaged bamboo shoot sample in breach of food labelling regulation
records.hazard: The CFS collected the above-mentioned sample from an online shop for testing under its routine Food Surveillance Programme. The test result showed that the sample contained sulphur dioxide. Although the sulphur dioxide level detected is within the legal limit, the functional class and the name of the additive were not declared on the food label of the sample. Sulphur dioxide is a commonly used preservative in a variety of foods including dried vegetables, dried fruits, pickled vegetables and salted fish products. This preservative is water soluble, most of it can be removed through washing and cooking. However, susceptible individuals who are allergic to this preservative may experience breathing difficulties, headaches and nausea after consumption. The use of preservatives in food must comply with the Preservatives in Food Regulation (Cap. 132BD). Furthermore, the Food and Drugs (Composition and Labelling) Regulations (Cap. 132W) require that for all prepackaged food for sale in Hong Kong containing sulphite in a concentration of 10 parts per million or more, the functional class of the sulphite and its name shall be specified in the list of ingredients. Offenders are liable to a maximum fine of $50,000 and six months' imprisonment upon conviction.
records.remedy: Members of the public should not consume the affected batch of the product.

records.title: Not to consume three batches of French cheese suspected to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes
productNames: Not to consume three batches of French cheese suspected to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes
records.hazard: The Centre for Food Safety (CFS) received a notification from the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed of the European Commission that the above-mentioned products were possibly contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. A preliminary investigation found that the above-mentioned importers had imported into Hong Kong the affected batches of the products concerned. Listeria monocytogenes can be easily destroyed by cooking but can survive and multiply at refrigerator temperature. Most healthy individuals do not develop symptoms or only have mild symptoms such as fever, muscle pain, headache, nausea, vomiting or diarrhoea when infected. However, severe complications such as septicaemia, meningitis or even death may occur in newborns, the elderly and those with a weaker immune system. Although infected pregnant women may just experience mild symptoms generally, the infection of Listeria monocytogenes may cause miscarriage, infant death, preterm birth, or severe infection in newborns. In order to reduce the risk of listeriosis, susceptible populations such as pregnant women should consume freshly prepared hot food where possible, reheat chilled food until it is hot all the way through, and avoid high-risk foods, including ready-to-eat food such as cold cuts, cold smoked seafood, soft cheeses, salads, etc, or cook them thoroughly before consumption, even if they are presented as part of a dish.

rows.label: Reason For Issuing Alert
rows.value: The Centre for Food Safety (CFS) received a notification from the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed of the European Commission that the above-mentioned products were possibly contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. A preliminary investigation found that the above-mentioned importers had imported into Hong Kong the affected batches of the products concerned. Listeria monocytogenes can be easily destroyed by cooking but can survive and multiply at refrigerator temperature. Most healthy individuals do not develop symptoms or only have mild symptoms such as fever, muscle pain, headache, nausea, vomiting or diarrhoea when infected. However, severe complications such as septicaemia, meningitis or even death may occur in newborns, the elderly and those with a weaker immune system. Although infected pregnant women may just experience mild symptoms generally, the infection of Listeria monocytogenes may cause miscarriage, infant death, preterm birth, or severe infection in newborns. In order to reduce the risk of listeriosis, susceptible populations such as pregnant women should consume freshly prepared hot food where possible, reheat chilled food until it is hot all the way through, and avoid high-risk foods, including ready-to-eat food such as cold cuts, cold smoked seafood, soft cheeses, salads, etc, or cook them thoroughly before consumption, even if they are presented as part of a dish.

Listeria monocytogenes can be easily destroyed by cooking but can survive and multiply at refrigerator temperatures. Most healthy individuals do not develop symptoms or only have mild symptoms such as fever, muscle pain, headache, nausea, vomiting or diarrhoea when infected. However, severe complications such as septicaemia, meningitis or even death may occur in newborns, the elderly and those with a weaker immune system. Although infected pregnant women may just experience mild symptoms generally, the infection of Listeria monocytogenes may cause miscarriage, infant death, preterm birth, or severe infection in newborns. Action Taken by the Centre for Food Safety Upon learning of the incident, the CFS immediately contacted local importers to follow up. As a precautionary measure, the importer concerned has stopped sales and removed from shelves the affected batch of the product and has initiated a recall according to the CFS's instructions. The CFS has contacted the French authority over the incident and will continue to follow up on the incident and take appropriate action to safeguard food safety and public health. The investigation is ongoing. Advice to the Trade Stop using or selling the affected batch of the product immediately. Advice to Consumers Stop consuming the affected batch of the product and seek medical treatment if they feel unwell after consuming the product concerned. Further Information The CFS press release Members of the public may call the importer's hotline at 2736 3866 during office hours for enquiries about the recall.

records.title: Imported prepackaged black cod steak sample detected with methylmercury level exceeding legal limit
productNames: Imported prepackaged black cod steak sample detected with methylmercury level exceeding legal limit
records.hazard: The CFS collected the above-mentioned sample from an online shop for testing under its routine Food Surveillance Programme. The test result showed that the sample contained methylmercury at a level of 0.8 milligram per kilogram, exceeding the legal limit of 0.5 mg per kg. Methylmercury is the major form of mercury in fish. At high levels, mercury can affect foetal brain development, and affect vision, hearing, muscle co-ordination and memory in adults. Furthermore, as some international organisations such as the World Health Organization have pointed out, consuming predatory fish species is the main source of mercury intake for human beings. The report of the CFS's Total Diet Study has also pointed out that large fish or predatory fish species may contain high mercury levels (for example, tuna, alfonsino, shark, swordfish, marlin, orange roughy and king mackerel). Hence, groups particularly susceptible to the adverse effects of mercury, such as pregnant women, women planning a pregnancy and young children should opt for fish that are smaller in size for consumption and avoid consumption of the above-mentioned types of fish to minimise excessive exposure to metal contaminants in food.

versions.riskDescription: The sound pressure level produced by the musical percussion toy is too high (measured value: 115 dB) and the product does not bear the required warning signs concerning this risk. This could lead to permanent or partial hearing loss. Additionally, the toy has small parts (the fisher hook magnet in the hook, pieces of the plastic body of the hook and magnet) that can easily detach. A small child could put it in the mouth and choke. Moreover, these magnets have a high magnetic flux (measured value: 176 kG²mm²)  If a child swallows them, they could attract one another causing intestinal blockage or perforation.
versions.legalProvision: The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive.
versions.riskTypeOther: + risk of intestinal perforation if swallowed

records.title: Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs
productNames: The affected battery packs are lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs that are designed for exclusive use in Bose S1 Pro Portable Bluetooth® Speaker Systems and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth® Speaker Systems. The battery packs are designed to be replaceable and may have been purchased either with the speaker systems or as a standalone accessory. The recall applies only to the affected battery packs, not to the speaker systems themselves.
Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ System Battery Packs
records.hazard: Risk of serious injury, damage to property or both if the lithium-ion battery pack overheats and catches fire. Incidents of overheating have occurred.
records.remedy: Check if your battery pack is affected by locating the 17-digit serial number on the battery pack label. If the battery pack serial number begins with any one of the following six digits, the battery pack is recalled: 083723, 078352, 084105, 078591, 078592, 084106, or 086409. Immediately stop using the battery pack and remove it from your speaker. Contact Bose or the site below to receive a replacement battery pack free of charge. You will need the battery pack serial number, as shown in the instructions here, to request a replacement. While you wait for your replacement battery, you can use your S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth Speaker System while connected to mains power without the battery pack installed. Do not dispose of battery packs in household rubbish or in general recycling. Battery pack disposal should be in accordance with local requirements for recalled lithium-ion battery disposal.
records.description: Product: The affected battery packs are lithium-ion rechargeable battery packs that are designed for exclusive use in Bose S1 Pro Portable Bluetooth® Speaker Systems and S1 Pro+ Portable Bluetooth® Speaker Systems. The battery packs are designed to be replaceable and may have been purchased either with the speaker systems or as a standalone accessory. The recall applies only to the affected battery packs, not to the speaker systems themselves. Brand/company: Bose Supplier: BOSE PTY LIMITED Reason: The affected battery packs have certain settings that do not adequately detect and respond to deteriorating or damaged battery cells, which could cause the battery packs to overheat and catch fire. detail.hazards: Children are at risk of choking, severe internal burn injuries or death if they swallow or place button/coin batteries inside their bodies. Serious injury can occur in as little as 2 hours and the results can be fatal. In Australia, children have suffered serious injuries or died from swallowing button/coin batteries. If you suspect a child has swallowed or inserted a button or coin battery: Call Triple Zero (000) if your child is bleeding or having any difficulty breathing. Call the Poisons Information Centre immediately on 13 11 26, available 24 hours a day. They can direct you to an appropriate medical facility. Early action can save lives. Do not wait for symptoms to develop.
detail.consumerAction: Stop using the product immediately and keep out of reach of children. Return the product to the place of purchase for a full refund. Contact Golden Sun if you require further assistance with this recall.
